notes: Claim statuses travel unchanged per this binding's scenes block: definition/process/music Derived, quilt Argued. The governing chains stay intact: 0/1 = 4+2 = 5→0 = 0/1 and 1/0 = 4′+2′ = 5′→0′, with the Night primes as sequence addresses.

Rework 2026-10-07 (craft lane 4): all 28 word-label scenes replaced by drawn constructions — each ascii plate is the record's own operation (the nested 0/1 derivation, the T1 square, the 2×3→wait, the CRT is formal-neighbours; here the 64+36 bar, the fundamental square, the Möbius stitch, the three pairing arcs, the seven-frame selection). Geometry carries state: the collapsing disc under the immutable subject, the 3-4-5 triangle, the anchor ring with its selected dot.

Colour: nine grounds across four files — definition cool ink/plum, process violet/orchid-rose, quilt jade/deep-jade and a Night ground for the return, music amber/ember. Tints travel per file; gold reserved for earned closures (the recount, the perfect number, the stitch, the selected anchor).
Stillness: chapters of 2-3 scenes hold field, engine, view and morph byte-identical (16 of 27 adjacent pairs still); motion at file and half-file turns.
Stage text 93 words across 28 scenes — a title each, one short line on eight.
description: Binary Explication four-file circuit: definition, process, quilt, music — 28 addressable matheme scenes from "I see x" to the musical-epistemic return.
